g.text: ttt — one board, four ways of looking at it
X has played cell 1, O has played cell 3
— nine slots, each one taken or free.
The array starts at 0, the cells are numbered from 1:
sit beside it in the same struct.
so the board is its own legend: what you read is what you type.
— the board is the argument of a
no score, no length field. The newline ends it.
draws it and forgets it. Whose turn it is was
— one X and one O, equal, and X starts,
so it is X's turn. One source of truth, on the server.
Why send the whole board every time,
Because then a client can never drift out of
step. It holds no game state of its own — it
draws what it is given. A confused client just
again and is correct once more.
